01
ABOUT

Empowering Jharkhand's students to learn, research, innovate and achieve at the highest level.

CM Fellowship Scheme for Academic Excellence is a Government of Jharkhand initiative aimed at promoting higher and technical education, academic excellence, and research among students pursuing studies in universities, colleges, engineering colleges, and polytechnic institutions.

Announced in the State Budget 2017–18, the scheme provides support for research work and fellowships, paper presentation and academic participation, higher education in foreign universities, and other academic excellence initiatives.

The scheme reflects the State Government's commitment to qualitative improvement and the all-round development of higher and technical education in Jharkhand.
